title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Abolishing Some Judicial Interpretations (Thirteenth Batch)

articles.content_en:
July 8, 2019
Supreme People's Court
Decision on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations (Thirteenth Batch)
Fa Shi [2019] No. 11
For the purpose of adapting to developments and changes in the situation and ensuring the uniform and correct application of national laws, and pursuant to relevant legal provisions and the actual needs of adjudication, it is hereby decided to abolish 103 judicial interpretations (the list is attached). The abolished judicial interpretations shall no longer apply from the date on which this Decision comes into force; however, judgments and rulings previously made on relevant cases pursuant to these judicial interpretations shall remain effective.
This Decision shall come into force as of July 20, 2019.
